description.zh: USB 供网的状态与修复
description.en: State and repair of the USB uplink for the PC

note.zh: 重新插拔 USB 后内核可能不再枚举设备（docs/USB-SHARE.md 2）。开启时由守护重绑 gadget 并把 usb0 放回 br-lan。
note.en: After a replug the kernel may stop enumerating the device (docs/USB-SHARE.md 2). While on, the guard rebinds the gadget and puts usb0 back into br-lan.

note.zh: 守护两次检查之间等待的秒数，改完立即生效。
note.en: Seconds the guard waits between two checks; a change takes effect at once.
